posts.name: Robin Brooks
posts.text:
Italy's TARGET2 liability (black) is counterpart to cumulative ECB buying of Italian gov't debt (blue). Private capital flows to Italy collapsed from 2010. Official flows - ECB QE - replaced them. That's what TARGET2 is. And - yes - it's debt Italy owes...
https://robinjbrooks.substack.com/p/ecb-yield-caps-and-target2-balances

posts.name: Robin Brooks
posts.text: @ilpetulante No, it's debt owed by Italy, Spain and others primarily to Germany. The way to see that is to think about an EM as a counterexample. If foreign capital inflows collapse in an EM, it devalues. We can't do that in the Euro, so official flows replace private ones. That's debt...
